kind: UI-only offscreen replay, the GPUI app against harness-nano, same replay and sampler

conditions.replay: apps/nano/bench/make_replay.py (885 frames: a 40-section reply in 24-character appends every 20 ms)
conditions.method: apps/nano/bench/resource.py: scripts/macos-resource-stat.c every 500 ms; CPU and wakeup rates exclude the first 2 s of each phase, but phase memory peaks include every sample; each binary saves complete.png at the settle, as the GPUI example does. Both GPUI references use this checkout's target/app-dev/examples; nano mirrors GPUI's connected and per-frame session state, including the working animation during streaming. Zero-footprint exit samples are ignored rather than counted as resting memory. The nano ReleaseFast binaries are rebuilt after the parity checker (which installs debug binaries by default).

binaries.nano: apps/nano/src/profile.zig (ReleaseFast, growing image atlas, transactional transcript recovery, build-time compiled Harness file-icon manifest and weighted text fields)
